Drayton's rule (a request-to-search encounter is not a seizure where a reasonable person would feel free to decline, and officers need not advise of the right to refuse consent) is the consensual-encounter/voluntary-consent doctrine that underlies knock-and-talk, so the role is doctrinally supportable.
